semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in super-hard materials and precision abrasives specifically for semiconductor applications.
summary: HeNan Union Precision Material Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of synthetic diamond powders and precision abrasives tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their products support various applications, including integrated circuits and silicon carbide materials, ensuring high-quality surface finishes and precision in semiconductor fabrication processes.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Henan, China, and has established itself as a high-tech enterprise recognized by the provincial government.
